title: Crypto’s first big tax win comes with a catch for stakers and everyday payments
content:
Crypto groups are pressing Congress to broaden tax relief after a House panel advanced the first digital-asset tax framework.
The House Ways and Means Committee approved H.R. 10357, the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, by 38-5 on Sept. 16, sending a package covering crypto payments, stablecoins, trading, lending, staking and mining toward the full House. The committee ordered the amended bill favorably reported after adopting Chairman Jason Smith’s substitute.
